Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，古代 already expresses a time period, so adding 的时候 is redundant. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，医 alone is not the usual noun for the profession in this context; 医生 means “doctor.” [rule: word_choice]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：一看到，看 describes the process of looking, while 看到 is needed here because the sentence means that he sees someone. [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，别人 refers to other people generally; 别的 is used to distinguish a different one or type from one already discussed. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一棵很漂亮的植物，棵 is an appropriate measure word for an individual plant; 个 is too general here. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他不知道：不知道，within the same sentence, the subject has already been named, so use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农听说：他听说，use a pronoun when the same character was mentioned in the immediately preceding sentence and no competing character is present. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：他，use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence of the same character. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 三个月走去，找到：走了三个月，找到了，use 了 to mark the completed three-month journey and the completed result of finding the place; 走去 also normally needs a stated destination, so it should not be used after the duration phrase here. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 什么病人吃都会：什么病人吃了都会，eating is completed before the resulting improvement, so use 了 after 吃. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代已经表示时间段，古代的时候在这里重复了。
表示职业应说医生，医不能单独这样使用。
这里表示“看见人”而不是进行看的动作，应使用看到。
这里应是病人；改成别人虽然可成句，但没有改正原句所要表达的人。
一个植物虽不如一棵植物具体自然，但并非错误。
两个分句之间重复他是可接受的，并不构成必须删除的指代错误。
新句重新使用神农是清楚且可接受的，不必强制改为他。
神农在这里重新作后续事件的主语是可接受的，不是指代错误。
走了三个月正确标明完成的持续动作，找到了也可正确标明找到的完成。
这里应改为吃了以后来明确先吃后身体变好，只加了没有完成该修正。
